description: This file implements handlers for generating and managing bbfdm events on ubus, including event registration, callback handling, and cleanup.

methods.name: get_events_dm_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device management path for a given event from the list of event handlers.

methods.name: event_callback
methods.description: Callback function to send an event via ubus.

methods.name: bbfdm_event_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming ubus events, executes commands, and schedules event notifications.

methods.name: add_ubus_event_handler
methods.description: Adds a new ubus event handler to the list.

methods.name: register_events_to_ubus
methods.description: Registers events with ubus based on schema data and sets up handlers.

methods.name: free_ubus_event_handler
methods.description: Frees and unregisters all ubus event handlers in the list.
